name: Pitztaler Burgerstadl Mandarfen
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pitztal’s Burgerstadl in Mandarfen, Tirol**

Discover the cozy charm of **Pitztaler Burgerstadl** in **Mandarfen**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. This rustic mountain inn invites you to savor hearty Alpine dishes, from creamy **Käsespätzle** to tender **Tiroler Gröstl**, all paired with crisp local beers and smooth **Schnaps**. Warm up by the crackling fireplace, enjoy panoramic views of the **Ötztal Alps**, and indulge in homemade sweets like fluffy **Kaiserschmarrn** dusted with powdered sugar. Whether you're hiking through the **Pitztal Valley** or seeking a peaceful retreat, this traditional **Burgerstadl** offers an authentic taste of **Tirol’s** hospitality.
